meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构查找并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常常要成批改动代码或统一代码风格。
copy.tagline_en: Find code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely refactor code patterns across many files.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 会使用 ast-grep 工具按代码的语法结构（而非纯文本）进行搜索与改写，支持25种语言。它能匹配特定形状的函数、调用、导入等，批量替换代码，还能运行 YAML 规则扫描和自动修复。
howto.when: 当用户要求按代码结构查找或改写，例如找特定形状的函数/调用/导入、重写 console.log 为 logger.info、移除 as any 时触发。若目标是文本内容，则改用 grep/rg。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses ast-grep for AST-based search/rewrite in 25 languages. Matches functions/calls/imports by shape, does batch rewrites, and runs YAML rules with auto-fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for structural code search or rewrite, e.g. find functions/calls/imports with a shape, change console.log to logger.info, or strip as any. Use grep/rg for text-level queries instead.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) in the project.
say_en.note: Shows a preview first, then applies after confirmation.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Returns file locations and matching lines.

say_en.text: Remove all as any casts from the codebase.
say_en.note: Checks matches first, then removes them.
